content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Medical Officer: MBBS recognized by National Medical Commission (NMC). Registered with NMC / State Medical Council. One year of working experience in a hospital attached to a Medical College/Corporate Hospital. Desirable: Post Graduate Medical Sciences.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 65 years as on 30-09-2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The conducting organization for this recruitment is the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), which has published the official notification for medical professionals in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under TISS Medical Officer Notification 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Medical Officer position under this recruitment notification released by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for TISS Medical Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 is 05-10-2026. Candidates must apply prior to this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for TISS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC), be registered with the NMC or State Medical Council, and possess one year of hospital experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Medical Officer position at the Tata Institute of Social Sciences is 65 years as of the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. How much salary will a selected candidate receive?
faq.answer: Candidates selected for the Medical Officer post through this recruitment process will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 90,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- for submitting their online application form.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee concession for female candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, female candidates applying for the TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 are completely exempted from paying the application fee, listed as Nil.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for TISS Medical Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The applications for the Medical Officer position must be submitted strictly through online mode by visiting the official website of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Medical Officer posts at TISS will be based on a personal interaction process followed by necessary document verification steps.
